desc: Take long-range accuracy to the extreme with Savage Arms' Model 112 Magnum Target Bolt-Action Rifle in .338 Lapua magnum. Savage's Target AccuTrigger allows precision adjustment to the trigger pull, from 6 oz. to 2.5 lbs., for crisp, consistent shots on target every time. Heavy magnum 26" carbon-steel BA contour barrel with 1:9 rate of twist. Outfitted with a recoil-reducing muzzle brake. Grey matte-finished wood-laminate target stock. Single-shot capacity. Jeweled bolt. Drilled and tapped for scope mounts.
